About
Ana Gaia

Master of Psychology, educator, mother, and a human being walking this earth alongside you.

My work is simple: I bridge the clarity of Western science with the raw power of ancient wisdom to help you return to your authentic self.

For a long time, the world taught us to separate ourselves. To be either strictly analytical or deeply spiritual. To hide our human messiness behind rigid professional titles.

I am here to drop the labels. I don't look at you through the cold lens of academic diagnoses. I look at you as a whole person.

"Just turn off your mind." While the spiritual world kept shouting this phrase, I was sitting there thinking: How exactly do you expect to use the mind to turn off the mind?

Let's be honest. I was never that naturally hyper-intuitive, floaty person who could seamlessly drift into a meditative state on command. I have a massive, sharp, and deeply critical intellect. I know exactly how exhausting it is to live with a mind that never stops calculating, analyzing, and over-controlling.

I didn't reach inner peace by shutting my brain down — I trained it to cooperate. I chose to teach my mind how to expand, simply because I wanted to.

Because I possess that exact same analytical powerhouse, I know precisely how to work with yours. We will use your brilliant mind as an ally, not an enemy.

The Journey

Three Chapters.
One Synthesis.

Chapter I
The Foundation
Vienna, Austria
My journey began in the structured, rigorous world of Western academia, where I earned my Master's degree in Psychology. I mastered the classical disciplines, the science of behavior, and traditional clinical frameworks. Yet, the deeper I went, the more my intuition whispered that the mind alone couldn't release what the physical body still remembers.
Chapter II
The Initiation
Ashrams, Rituals & Bali
Seeking the missing pieces, I went directly to the origin. I lived in traditional ashrams, studied sacred lineages, and immersed myself in ancient rituals, breathwork, and Sound Medicine. I didn't just observe — I lived them, testing their effects on my own nervous system through years of practical refinement.
Chapter III
The Synthesis
Cascais & Lisbon, Portugal
Today, living on the cinematic coast of Portugal, I have brought these two worlds into a single synthesis. I don't choose between science and ancient wisdom — I choose both. I strip away the esoteric dogmas, packaging it into functional human technology for modern leaders.
The Philosophy

Any human experience
is lighter when lived through play.

Look at children — they process the world, heal, and learn entirely through play. Somewhere along the way, as adults carrying massive responsibilities, we forgot how to do that. We made the concept of personal growth heavy, serious, and utterly exhausting.

A truly mature psyche holds the capacity to play when needed, and to be grounded when the situation requires it. It's about emotional agility.

When we work together, we approach your patterns and somatic blocks with the curious, non-judgmental eyes of a child. Once you bring playfulness back, the fear and guilt dissolve.

Working With Me

A multi-layered
experience.

Because my own path is so vast, the therapeutic container I hold for you is equally multidimensional. You will encounter clinical precision, the primal resonance of sound, the depth of ancient ritual, and the liberating lightness of play.

The Psychologist
Clinical precision, evidence-based frameworks, and a Master's in Psychology. The analytical backbone that grounds every session in science.
The Somatic Guide
Pre-verbal bodywork, breathwork, vocal toning, and the Pravilo frame. Accessing what the mind cannot reach alone.
The Ritualist
Sacred ceremony, Sound Medicine, and ancient Balinese healing traditions. The primal technology of transformation.
The Educator
Founder of Neo Healing Academy and Path of the Creator course. Building practitioners for the next generation.
The Expedition Leader
Immersive retreat sanctuaries in Bali, Portugal, and beyond — for women ready to experience themselves in full volume.
The Human
A mother, an explorer, a woman with ambitions, imperfections, and bad days. I meet you exactly where you are.
